findings.title: Generic numeric sizing and loss limits risked appearing personalised
findings.evidence: Early framework text contained numeric initial-position, loss and factor examples without user data, history or a stress test.
findings.repair: Removed numeric allocation/risk limits from reader-facing framework; retained only non-activated sizing logic and q=0 boundary.
findings.verification: Final PDF text has no generic numeric allocation advice; case verifier checks this.

findings.title: Personal advantages and a 'best' core-satellite construction were stated too strongly
findings.evidence: No comparative cost, outcome or suitability data support a universal optimum claim.
findings.repair: Recast all core-satellite wording as a conditional candidate subject to fee, account, liquidity, tax and personal-constraint review; removed claims of inherent personal advantage.
findings.verification: Decision and transferability chapters use conditional language and retain zero as a valid direct-research allocation.

findings.title: Research-sleeve wording could be mistaken for an allocation instruction
findings.evidence: Phrases such as a small satellite or evidence position were too close to a generic position-sizing prescription despite q=0.
findings.repair: Replaced position language with a non-activated, potentially zero research dossier or research satellite and restated that no allocation is approved.
findings.verification: Decision, transferability and underwriting chapters all describe a research framework rather than a live allocation.
